summary: At revision 2026-10-15 a campaign is a container; status, send time and audience live on messages and campaign-audiences, and channel, template, subject and sender live on variations. Every campaign command resolves an ID through one resolver that accepts a container ID or a pre-2026-10-15 campaign ID, which is now a message ID.
reason: Klaviyo rejects the old messages.channel and status filters on /api/campaigns, old campaign IDs 404 on /api/campaigns/{id}, reporting rows group by message ID, and the legacy message template routes take a variation ID; code reading the old shapes returned 400s, 404s or empty reports.
validated_outcome: Live on a real account: qa-gate on a pre-2026-10-15 campaign ID returns a verdict; campaigns deploy creates an unscheduled draft with list inclusion and list plus segment exclusions and assigns a non-reusable template copy to the variation; image-swap updates that copy; campaign-clone reads back as draft; all test objects deleted.
